numeric_review: Aggregate event totals, matrix counts, and unchanged original final percentages checked. No causal residual or useful gain claimed.
privacy_review: Only aggregate results, CPU code, synthetic tests, source commits and review receipt hashes. No raw traces, requests, generated outputs, private file lists, credentials, or installation paths.

visual_review.inspection: Both final full-page renders visually inspected; tables wrap and content is readable.

limitations: Profiler results are not unprofiled speedup measurements
